x: Pat moved into a clear second place and at 15 miles was ½ min.in front of Mills(Sparkhill) and a further ½ min. ahead of McIntyre(Ponders End).
In a British Race Walkers Club 10 km at Paddington, Carl Lawton held A.A.A. 10km champion Mills of Ilford to 12 seconds in 45:39.6.
In gusty conditions Flynn, Mills and Adams blasted it from the start whilst further back Carl steadily tracked Nihill who was making his bid for a fourth appearance at the Olympics.
In the 10Km. event Adams (Leics.) won from Mills (Ilford) with Carl third, while over 3Km. the leading two reversed their positions again heading our man.
